availability pull drops unmatched feed entries, apply-availability.mjs keeps even a
zeroed player on the board), so this file is the only way onto it.
Each entry needs a `source` and either an explicit full-season `stats` line or a
`basis` naming a comparable already on the board at the same position, optionally
scaled. A `basis` line is an ESTIMATE standing in until a real projection arrives —

On first apply a derived line is captured into `stats` so it stops moving when the
comparable moves. After that the row belongs to the board and apply-availability.mjs
may pro-rate it or move a share of an absent team-mate's line onto it.
Apply with `node tools/add-players.mjs`; CI runs it with --check. Confirm team and
position against ESPN's live rosters with --verify.
